description.en: WorkBuddy skill market for DSH: scan a WorkBuddy skills folder, normalize and dedupe skill ids, then install whole skill folders into your DSH skills directory from a Settings panel — one click per card, backup-before-overwrite, and a delete action.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 技能市场：扫描 WorkBuddy 技能目录，规范化 id、折叠重复副本后复制进 DSH 技能目录。卡片式面板一件安装/更新/删除，覆盖前自动备份，源目录与目标目录可在面板里改。
